name: Uno
subtitle: The classic colour clash.
rules: Match the colour, number or symbol.
Call UNO when one card remains.
Empty your hand first. Draw four may be challenged.

name: Uno No Mercy
subtitle: Friendships, on hard mode.
rules: Match the colour, number or symbol.
Call UNO when one card remains.
25 cards means elimination; stack equal or higher draws.

name: Monopoly Deal
subtitle: Build an empire, one card at a time.
rules: Collect three complete property sets in different colours.
Draw two and play up to three cards per turn. Keep at most seven.
Bank money to pay rent. Counter attacks with Just Say No.

name: Monopoly Deal No Mercy
subtitle: Games house deck. No mercy.
rules: Collect three complete property sets in different colours.
Draw two and play up to three cards per turn. Keep at most seven.
Debt must be settled before your own plays. Nothing is safe.
Games house deck: 18 money cards — 5×1M, 4×2M, 3×3M, 2×4M, 2×5M, 1×10M, 1×15M. Printed action effects; money copy counts are a house convention.

name: Texas Hold’em
subtitle: Find your seat at the table.
rules: Make the best five-card hand from your two cards and five community cards.
Blinds 1/2. Each player starts with 200 free chips.
No-limit betting, side pots and split pots are supported.

name: Rummy
subtitle: A good hand comes together.
rules: Draw one, discard one, and arrange your 13 cards.
Declare with two sequences, including one pure sequence.
Points format. Jokers are wild; maximum loss is 80 points.

name: Teen Patti
subtitle: Three cards. Endless possibilities.
rules: Play blind or look at your three cards and play seen.
Trail beats sequence, colour, pair and high card.
Free chips only. Boot 1; base stake cap 64; pot cap 1024.

name: Blackjack
subtitle: A little luck. A little nerve.
rules: Get closer to 21 than the dealer without going over.
Blackjack pays 3:2. Ties return your stake.
Split pairs or double on two cards.

name: Skyjo
subtitle: Small numbers. Big surprises.
rules: Reveal two cards, then trade to lower your grid's score.
Three matching revealed cards in a column disappear.
At 100 total points, the lowest score wins.

name: Pop Tarot
subtitle: Your plot twist is in the cards.
rules: Think of a question, or simply see what comes up.
Pick three cards: where you are, what is shifting, your next move.
Get an AI-written personal reading with a pop-culture twist.
A playful reflection, not a prediction or professional advice.

name: Four in a Row
subtitle: One more move. Four in a row.
rules: Drop a disc into an open column.
Connect four horizontally, vertically or diagonally to win.
A full board without a four-in-a-row is a draw.

name: Reversi
subtitle: Turn the whole table around.
rules: Place a disc to bracket and flip an opponent’s line.
You must pass when no capturing placement is available.
When neither player can move, the most discs wins.

name: Word Agents
subtitle: One clue. A room full of possibilities.
rules: Two spymasters know the key. Their teams see only the words.
Give a one-word clue and a number; your team gets up to one extra guess.
Find all your agents and avoid the assassin.

name: Gem Market
subtitle: Small gems. A brilliant empire.
rules: Collect gems, reserve a card or buy a development each turn.
Developments discount future purchases; patrons reward a balanced engine.
At 15 prestige, finish the round. Most prestige wins; fewer developments breaks a tie.

name: Checkers
subtitle: A small move. A clever little trap.
rules: Move diagonally forward on dark squares. Captures are compulsory.
Finish every available jump with the same piece; choose any capture path.
Reach the far row to become a king. Crowning ends that turn; kings move either way.
Win when the other player has no pieces or legal move. Threefold repetition or 40 moves each without a capture/man move draws.

name: Mancala
subtitle: Sow a little. Steal a march.
rules: Kalah: four seeds in each of twelve pits, with two stores starting empty.
Choose a pit on your side. Sow counterclockwise, including your store and skipping your opponent’s.
Finish in your store to play again. Finish in your empty pit opposite seeds to capture both.
When either side empties, sweep the other side into its own store. Most seeds wins; equal stores draw.
